description_en: Hot baths, saunas, sheep-head towels, baked eggs — and people really sleep here overnight. Learn 찜질방 (jjimjilbang), 양머리 (sheep-head towel) and 여기서 자요 (people sleep here). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: Sleep in Korea for ten dollars?
hook_id: Tidur di Korea dengan sepuluh dolar?
hook_voice: Sleep in Korea for ten dollars?

hook_voice_parts.text: Sleep in Korea for ten dollars?

scenes.vi: Bồn tắm nóng, sauna, một sảnh lớn.
scenes.id: Bak air panas, sauna, satu aula besar.
scenes.voice: 찜질방. Hot baths, saunas, and one big hall.

voice_parts.text: Hot baths, saunas, and one big hall.

scenes.en: Roll the towel into sheep horns.
scenes.vi: Cuốn khăn thành sừng cừu. Rồi ăn trứng nướng.
scenes.id: Gulung handuk jadi tanduk domba. Lalu telur bakar.
scenes.voice: 양머리. Roll the towel into sheep horns. Then baked eggs and sikhye.

voice_parts.text: Roll the towel into sheep horns. Then baked eggs and sikhye.

scenes.en: People sleep here. All night. Strangers.
scenes.vi: Người ta ngủ thật. Cả đêm. Ngay cạnh người lạ.
scenes.id: Orang benar-benar tidur di sini. Semalam. Di sebelah orang asing.
scenes.voice: 여기서 자요. And yes: people really sleep here overnight, right next to strangers.

voice_parts.text: And yes: people really sleep here overnight, right next to strangers.

cta.vi: Vậy bạn có ngủ ở đây không? 👇
cta.voice: 푹 쉬세요. Rest well. So, would you sleep here for ten dollars?

voice_parts.text: Rest well. So, would you sleep here for ten dollars?
